stopping: Fixed budgets; no performance-based stopping, test-driven selection or automatic paid retries.
goal_interface: Final two-view target images and image-derived change weights only; no object truth, subgoals, hand path or task name reaches learned policies.
prediction_scope: Rigid objects: image prediction plus frozen diagnostic readouts of pose, velocity, angular velocity, contact and object identity; labeled probes never enter world-model optimization or planning.
seal: Training, adaptation and probe fitting finish before final evaluation. New code/protocol after viewing final results requires a new namespace and run ID.
interpretation: Fully synthetic, random initialization. Same PyBullet point effector and programmed grasp primitive. Research implementation inspired by latent-dynamics planning, not a published-method reproduction. This protocol tests capabilities; it does not guarantee them or test consciousness.
